question: Does C-0103's count effect at fixed station geometry hold at the other 31 crossover phases, and is its decomposition of the recommended 34 -> 30 move into a count term and a phase term well posed?

conditions.tile: 40.0 x 40.35 nm single-layer square-lattice sheet, 15 duplexes at 2.69 nm
conditions.load: C-0022's SOLVED edge profile at 2.0 mM, 10 nm, 0.192 V
conditions.mandate: C-0017's 33.3333333 pN/nm as a SUM at S3's acceptable 3 nm, shared EQUALLY at every count and every phase
conditions.dropout: C-0087's MEASURED_DEPTH incorporation field, one Bernoulli stream PER PHASE over that phase's own site inventory, restricted per subset
conditions.statistic: the 90th percentile, nearest rank, over the free-tile stroke
conditions.flatness: T-5b's 0.10 CONVENTION, not a physical threshold
conditions.family: the CANONICAL search-free nested chain: one root per row at the site nearest the tile centre, grown by C-0103's own addition rule

decision: THE COUNT EFFECT DOES NOT HOLD AT EVERY PHASE: it is adverse at 27 of 32 swept phases and favourable at 5. The count term runs -4.595196 to 12.205899 per cent against C-0103's +12.8596328 per cent at phase 24. The two axes are NOT separable to 1 % of a level: the balanced two-way additive fit over the graded grid leaves a worst residual of 7.725089 per cent of a level, 1.532347 of its own count main effect, carrying 9.792182 per cent of the total variation. On the recommendation's own 2 x 2 the count term is 10.839768 per cent taken first and 4.475321 per cent taken second, an interaction of -5.742024 per cent, i.e. 0.574595 of the term it splits. Nothing here is flat: 192 of 192 graded canonical cells exceed T-5b's 0.10 at the 90th percentile.

cheapBounds.name: bound 1 — C-0089's single-removal instrument over the whole swept grid, n solves per cell and no sampling: its own two-way interaction
cheapBounds.settles: whether the interaction can be screened without the ensemble at all; the graded grid measures 7.725089 per cent

cheapBounds.name: bound 2 — C-0098's OWN graded array cells at full upward inventory, read at run time: the phase term between C-0063's 24 and C-0074's 8
cheapBounds.settles: the SIGN of the phase term at a nearly matched count (53 against 52 ties). C-0103's subtraction attributes -19.0 per cent to the phase; the only published grading of the two phases on the array runs the other way

cheapBounds.name: bound 3 — the path identity: the two orderings of the 2 x 2 share their endpoints, so they differ by exactly one number
cheapBounds.settles: how expensive the headline is. The interaction on the recommendation's own move is a function of four cells and not of the whole grid; the 32-phase grid buys the generality and not the verdict

falsifiers.name: F1

findings: THE COUNT TERM AT EVERY PHASE. The 34 -> 30 reduction at fixed station geometry is adverse at 27 of 32 crossover phases and favourable at 5. It runs from -4.595196 per cent (phase 25) to 12.205899 per cent (phase 6), against C-0103's +12.8596328 per cent measured at phase 24 on its own anchor. So the sign is NOT a property of the count: at 5 phases the reduction is free or better, which is what F1 declared.

C-0103's OWN FALSIFIER, RE-READ AT EVERY PHASE — AND THE BREAKS ARE AT THE SPARSE END, NOT AT THE RECOMMENDATION'S STEP. Its F1 asked whether the 90th percentile is monotone decreasing in the path count over 22 -> 45 at fixed station geometry; on the CANONICAL search-free family that holds at 0 of 32 phases, and the step-by-step census is 22 -> 25: 30 of 32 non-decreasing, 25 -> 28: 14 of 32 non-decreasing, 28 -> 30: 0 of 32 non-decreasing, 30 -> 34: 5 of 32 non-decreasing, 34 -> 45: 5 of 32 non-decreasing. The canonical rule is not C-0103's chain A, so this is a statement about an anchor rule as well as about the lattice: what it establishes is that the monotonicity C-0103 measured is NOT robust to the rule at the sparse end, while the 34 -> 30 step the recommendation moves through is adverse at 27 of 32 phases.

THE TWO AXES ARE NOT SEPARABLE TO 1 % OF A LEVEL, AND THE MEASUREMENT IS A BALANCED TWO-WAY FIT. Over 32 phases and 6 counts the additive model in log p90 leaves a worst residual of 0.074412321 log units, i.e. 7.725089 per cent of a level. The phase carries 7.836103 per cent of the total variation, the count 82.371715 per cent and the interaction 9.792182 per cent; the worst residual is 1.532347 of the fit's own 34 -> 30 count main effect of 4.975941 per cent; the decomposition closes to 0.000000000, which is the orthogonality of a balanced design and is asserted as a gate.

AND THE CHEAP INSTRUMENT SAW IT FIRST, FOR n SOLVES A CELL AND NO SAMPLING. The single-removal grid's own interaction is 14.469263 per cent of a level against the graded grid's 7.725089 per cent, and its interaction share is 11.850375 per cent against 9.792182 per cent.

C-0103'S DECOMPOSITION IS ONE OF TWO PATHS ACROSS A 2 x 2, AND THE SPLIT IS PATH-DEPENDENT WHERE THE TOTAL IS NOT. On the canonical, search-free 2 x 2 between phases 24 and 8 the same journey reads: count first 10.839768 per cent then phase -3.925387 per cent; phase first 1.927303 per cent then count 4.475321 per cent. The total is 6.488877 per cent either way (path disagreement 0.000000000), and the two splits differ by the interaction, -5.742024 per cent — 0.574595 of the count term itself.

ON THE PUBLISHED DESIGNS THE SAME 2 x 2 READS 12.859633 per cent of count taken first and 2.929336 per cent taken second, an interaction of -8.798803 per cent. Its 34-at-phase-8 corner is a CONSTRUCTION and not an optimum, so the anchor qualities are not matched and this reading is offered beside the canonical one rather than instead of it.

AND THE PUBLISHED CROSS-CHECK RUNS THE OTHER WAY. C-0098's own graded ARRAY cells at full upward inventory read 6.526892 per cent going from phase 24 to phase 8 at a nearly matched count — a phase term of the OPPOSITE sign to the -19.0 per cent C-0103's subtraction attributes to the phase. That number was in the corpus before this task ran, it costs no solve, and it is read at run time from C-0098's own result file.

THE CHEAP RANKING INSTRUMENT DOES TRANSFER ACROSS PHASES ON THE ARRAY AT FIXED COUNT, WHICH IS NOT WHAT C-0098 MEASURED. Across counts within a phase Spearman rho runs 0.942857 to 1.000000 (32 of 32 transfer); across phases at FIXED count it runs 0.882698 to 0.978006 (6 of 6 transfer), against C-0089's 0.972896669 across designs and C-0098's 0.468487481 across phases. C-0098's rho = 0.468487481 is measured on the SHARED BODY over six phases at each phase's own FULL inventory, so its count moves with its phase (52, 53 and 60 ties); at fixed count on the array the instrument ranks 32 phases at 0.88-0.98. The axis the bound fails on is therefore narrower than 'the phase', and a phase screen on the array can be run for n solves a cell.

THE INTERACTION IS NOT A HOST EFFECT, BECAUSE IT SURVIVES INSIDE EVERY STRATUM. C-0102's three demands cut the 32 phases into structurally comparable sets, and the worst additive residual inside them is eight-column AND centro-symmetric (C-0063's two) 2.467982 per cent over 2 phases; eight-column (C-0015's ten) 6.719389 per cent over 8 phases; richest inventory, seven-column (C-0098's ten) 4.117180 per cent over 10 phases; seven-column, neither richest nor symmetric 6.951149 per cent over 12 phases.

THE HOSTS ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE AND THE CENSUS SAYS SO BEFORE ANY SOLVE. Of the 32 swept phases 10 are eight-column hosts, 10 carry the richest 60-site inventory and 2 are centro-symmetric; the uncoupled tile itself dishes 0.307902 to 0.312236 of the stroke across them, so the baseline a coupling is judged against is a function of the phase too.

UNDER THE MEASURED DROPOUT THIS WHOLE FAMILY IS A NET DISHING SOURCE AT EVERY PHASE. 192 of 192 canonical cells exceed their own host's uncoupled dishing at the 90th percentile, and 192 of 192 exceed T-5b's 0.10, the worst at 1.021610. So neither the count nor the phase decides an acceptance verdict on this branch, exactly as C-0103 found at one phase.

THE VERDICT ON C-0103's DEFENCE. F1 FIRED and F2 FIRED. The count effect is not one-signed across the phases, so C-0103's +12.86 per cent is a phase-24 reading rather than a property of the count. What does not generalise is the SPLIT: the interaction on the recommendation's own move is -5.742024 per cent, so 'the count term is +12.86 per cent and the phase term is -19.0 per cent' is one of two readings of the same journey and the other reading gives 1.927303 and 4.475321 per cent. The TOTAL is what the recommendation rests on, and the total is path-independent, so the defence survives on its endpoints and not on its decomposition.
validity: TRL 1-3. Model-consistent and traceable. The dropout INPUT is C-0087's, which is Strauss et al. (2018) read directly on a plain Rothemund rectangle; nothing derived here is measured.
The motif is NOT demonstrated: a free lever held to a single-layer sheet by one crossover is this programme's own construct (C-0028, C-0029, C-0055).

ONE anchor rule. The canonical family is search-free and therefore matched across phases, but it is a THIRD rule beside C-0103's two, and C-0103 measured up to 6 per cent of rule dependence between its own two chains below 30 paths. The levels carry that dependence; the signs and the interaction are what is read.
EQUAL springs at every cell. The distribution axis is C-0089's (1.30-1.61x on an array) and is T-179's; nothing here bounds the three-way interaction of count, phase and distribution.

ONE width and ONE load state: 40.00 nm, because the reproduction gates are written there, and C-0022's solved 2 mM / 10 nm / 0.192 V. C-0086/C-0090/C-0102 have moved the buildable width to 38.08 nm and the recommended phase to 8, where C-0102's census is the authority; C-0068 has shown a placement can reverse between layer heights.

The published-adjacent 2 x 2 has ONE constructed corner: 34 roots at phase 8 is C-0074's 30 grown by an addition rule, not an optimum, so its anchor quality is not matched to C-0063's exhaustively enumerated 34 at phase 24. The CANONICAL 2 x 2 carries no such asymmetry and is the primary reading.
The arm footprint is neither reported nor imposed here: an arm's length is a function of the count (C-0075) and buildability is a plan axis C-0069/C-0075/C-0103 own.
T-5b's 0.10 is a CONVENTION, not a physical threshold.

The dishing pipeline, the lattice, the hosts, the load and the free-tile stroke are C-0058's, C-0063's, C-0087's, C-0089's and C-0103's unchanged, and inherit C-0022's unsourced rim charge and C-0001's single foundation secant.
Single layer, static, 300 K, aqueous 2 mM MgCl2.
openQuestions: Whether the coupling element's own incorporation is the staple's — C-0087's item 2, unchanged, and still the only route by which this programme keeps a flat tile.
Whether a count sweep with the DISTRIBUTION freed at every count reorders the cells, and whether the interaction survives it. T-179.
Whether the same grid at C-0086's buildable 38.08 nm carries the same interaction. The congruences differ (C-0102), the inventory collapses, and the strata are not the same sets.
What fraction of built tiles a flatness verdict is owed over — C-0087's item 4, unchanged, and the parameter the whole branch is most sensitive to.
